skill.name: customer-support
skill.description: Create customer support workflows, chatbot plans, ticket routing guidance, and support analytics strategies.
skill.summary: Plan AI-assisted customer support workflows across chat, tickets, knowledge bases, and customer experience analytics.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code around a resource path in SKILL.md. No executable code, prompt injection attempt, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe business logic was found in the reviewed file.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 27 uses backticks only as Markdown inline formatting around a documentation path. There is no shell execution, code block, or instruction to run a command.

content.value_statement: Support teams need faster, consistent answers without losing empathy. This skill helps design chatbot flows, ticket workflows, knowledge bases, and CX measurement plans.
actual_capabilities: Designs chatbot flows for common support requests and escalation paths.
Plans ticket routing, prioritization, SLA handling, and follow-up workflows.
Creates knowledge base, FAQ, and troubleshooting content strategies.
Recommends omnichannel support patterns across email, chat, phone, and social channels.
Defines customer support metrics, satisfaction tracking, and improvement loops.
Outlines support team training, quality review, and crisis response practices.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates, not direct platform configuration.
It needs accurate policies, product details, and support data from the user.
It cannot verify live customer records or ticket history by itself.
Legal, privacy, and compliance decisions still require qualified review.

use_cases.title: Launch a Support Chatbot
use_cases.description: Build a clear chatbot plan for order status, billing, troubleshooting, and handoff requests.

use_cases.title: Improve Help Desk Routing
use_cases.description: Create triage rules, escalation paths, SLA priorities, and follow-up steps for a growing queue.

use_cases.title: Measure Customer Experience
use_cases.description: Define CSAT, NPS, sentiment, resolution time, and knowledge gap reporting for leadership reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a clear support reply for this customer issue. Use a helpful tone. Include next steps and a closing question.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Ticket Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ticket workflow for these request types. Include tags, priorities, SLA rules, escalation triggers, and follow-up messages.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Knowledge Base Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these recurring support topics. Propose a knowledge base structure, article titles, search terms, and maintenance process.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Omnichannel Support
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an omnichannel support model for these channels. Include customer context, handoffs, staffing, metrics, and quality controls.

output_examples.input: A customer asks why an order has not shipped after five business days.
output_examples.output: The skill can produce an empathetic reply, explain the status check process, request missing order details, and define escalation criteria.

output_examples.input: A team receives many password reset and billing tickets.
output: Route urgent billing failures to a specialist queue.
Offer self-service reset steps before creating a ticket.
Track deflection rate and customer satisfaction.

output_examples.input: A company wants to improve its help center search results.
output_examples.output: The skill can suggest article groups, title patterns, FAQ gaps, tagging rules, and a monthly review process.

best_practices: Provide product policies, escalation rules, and support metrics before asking for workflow design.
Review generated customer-facing text for brand voice, accuracy, and compliance before use.
Test chatbot and routing flows with real ticket examples before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent refund, privacy, or account policies.
Do not use generated replies without checking customer context.
Do not replace human escalation for urgent, sensitive, or complex issues.

faq.question: Can this skill write customer support replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft clear replies when you provide the issue, customer context, and policy constraints.

faq.question: Can it configure Zendesk or Intercom directly?
faq.answer: No. It can plan settings and workflows, but it does not directly configure external platforms.

faq.question: Does it support chatbot design?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design intents, handoff rules, fallback messages, and improvement metrics for chatbot workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with knowledge bases?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose article structures, FAQ topics, search terms, and maintenance routines.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but legal, privacy, and compliance requirements need expert review.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
